description: Asks what Chr, ChrW and the byte forms ChrB and AscB return for arguments across and beyond their ranges (negative, 127-129, 255, 256, fractional, text-numeric, Boolean, 65535, 65536, -32768), and what Asc, AscW return for multi-character, space, high-Latin-1, euro, lone-surrogate, empty and number operands. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
